arguments.text: 8000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod power vs heart rate and vs GPS speed for pod drift; correct pod_gain if it drifts. (2) Spot drag (weed) via push_local dropping within a leg while heading constant; clear_rudder if so. (3) Handle radio messages (course changes: set_race_distance + tell). (4) Check the CP/reserve via heart-rate trend at steady effort mid-race. Avoid wasting cues; finish rule only spends reserve if pod reserve > 40% at 800 m to go.

arguments.name: boat_share
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; drops with drag/weed or pod reading high

arguments.name: pod_per_hr
arguments.description: pod watts per heart beat; rises if pod drifts high (HR lags effort ~1 min)
